name: Debra Laws
description: '''Debra Renee Laws''' (born September 10, 1956) is an American singer and actress from [[Houston]], Texas. She is best known for her 1981 R&B/soul ballad "[[Very Special (song)|Very Special]]". In her music career, she works closely with her siblings, [[Eloise Laws]], [[Hubert Laws]] and [[Ronnie Laws]], who are producers.
